mechanism_narrative: The consistent week-over-week increase in RETAIL_REC mobility over the past four weeks indicates an ongoing recovery trend that will continue to drive retail and recreation activity higher over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: As RESIDENTIAL mobility falls below 20% from baseline, it signifies a critical shift in public behavior towards spending significantly less time at home, directly increasing out-of-home activities like retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next two weeks, despite RESIDENTIAL remaining below 20% from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous and sustained increase in WORKPLACES and PARKS mobility indicates a broad return to both work and leisure activities outside the home, creating a synergistic effect that will boost RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the mean RETAIL_REC over the last 28 days, even if WORKPLACES and PARKS continue their upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: The widespread upward trend across RETAIL_REC, WORKPLACES, and TRANSIT mobility categories confirms an active and sustained government-led reopening policy, which will continue to drive overall public activity and RETAIL_REC upwards over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: A significant reversal or pause in government reopening policies is announced, or RETAIL_REC declines despite continued reopening.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week increase in PARKS mobility exceeding 5 percentage points signals a rapid surge in outdoor leisure activity, which will immediately translate into higher RETAIL_REC within the next week as people combine outdoor trips with retail visits.
candidate_trigger: PARKS mobility increases by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next week, despite PARKS mobility increasing by more than 5 percentage points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The consistent four-week decline in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates a fundamental and persistent shift in public behavior away from staying home, which will continue to free up time and opportunity for retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL mobility reverses its downward trend and increases over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC declines despite RESIDENTIAL continuing to fall.

mechanism_narrative: The combined upward trend in GROCERY_PHARM (essential outings) and TRANSIT (broader movement) indicates a general increase in public mobility and confidence, which will collectively drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next two weeks, even if both GROCERY_PHARM and TRANSIT continue their upward trends.

mechanism_narrative: The accelerating upward trend across RETAIL_REC, WORKPLACES, PARKS, and TRANSIT mobility from t-1w to t-0w signifies an active and intensifying reopening policy environment, which will lead to an immediate increase in RETAIL_REC within the next week.
failure_condition: Any local or national policy announcement within the next week that halts or reverses reopening measures would invalidate this mechanism.
